findings_high.title: structuredData is null during regenerating status
findings_high.description: The structuredData variable is gated on statusValue === 'current' only. When statusValue === 'regenerating' and renderSucceeded() is called (line 122-123), structuredData is null. The user sees a degraded summary view missing skills, domains, gaps, achievements, applicable experience, and other structured data sections during regeneration.
findings_high.fix: Change line 49 from: const structuredData = statusValue === "current" ? fullSummary?.structuredData : null; to: const structuredData = (statusValue === "current" || statusValue === "regenerating") ? fullSummary?.structuredData : null;

findings_med.title: Controller show action missing eager load for ai_job_application_summary_status
findings_med.description: The show action includes :latest_ai_job_application_summary (no longer used by serializer) but not :ai_job_application_summary_status (now used). One extra lazy-load query per show request. Works correctly but suboptimal.

findings_med.title: Dead eager load for :latest_ai_job_application_summary in show action
findings_med.description: The show action still includes :latest_ai_job_application_summary which the serializer no longer uses. Wasted query.

findings_med.title: Inconsistent broadcast coverage between pipeline services
findings_med.description: score_job_application.rb and integrate_analysis.rb were switched to update (enabling broadcasts) but generate.rb was not. Per spec.

findings_med.title: JobApplicationNavItem checks 'succeeded' instead of 'current'
findings_med.description: Pre-existing on base branch. Harvey dot never renders.

findings_med.title: WebSocket handler doesn't invalidate jobApplicationsForStage
findings_med.description: The ai_summary_status_change handler invalidates jobApplication and aiJobApplicationSummary but not jobApplicationsForStage. GlobalChannel's AI_SUMMARY_COMPLETE handler covers this for final states.

findings_med.title: PlatoLoadingState defaults to step 1, visually skipping step 0
findings_med.description: When status is undefined on first render, active defaults to 1. Step 0 'Processing the resume' is never shown as the active step.
